name: devops-azure
description: Use when the user asks about Azure, AKS, App Service, Bicep or ARM templates, Entra ID (Azure AD), managed identity, Azure Policy, Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Front Door, or a CAF landing zone. Produces Azure architectures and Bicep/CLI configs. Not for Azure Functions and Durable Functions (use cloud-native-azure-functions) or AWS (use aws).
